title: fix(settings)!: retire @objectstack/knowledge-ragflow and the Knowledge page's RAGFlow adapter option
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgFiXLbrG7d8JVydkmtSf4Bt)_

Fixes #37004

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — narrowed: `PUT /api/settings/knowledge` refuses `adapter: 'ragflow'` (`400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION`, field code `invalid_option`) and refuses `ragflow_base_url`, `ragflow_api_key` and `ragflow_default_dataset` (`400 UNKNOWN_KEY`), where it stored all four; `POST /api/settings/knowledge/test` answers `adapter = ragflow` as an unknown adapter (`400 SETTINGS_ACTION_FAILED`), where it answered a form check
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` and its eval case 3 teach the `pgvector` adapter where they taught `ragflow`; `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`, `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` and `content/docs/ai/index.mdx` name the adapters this repository builds.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在「知识库」设置页的后端下拉里不再有 RAGFlow 选项和它的三个配置项；以前选过它的环境，下拉显示为空，重新选一个后端保存即可。
- 为什么做：属于知识库平台边界整理；这个 RAGFlow 对接包发出的请求和对方接口对不上，绑定它的知识源从来搜不到内容，按裁决整包退役而不是修。
- 出错会怎样：还在用这个对接包的部署，升级后知识源搜索为空且只留一条警告日志；撤回这次合并即可恢复，已保存的配置一条都没删。
- 要你做什么：去掉它的版本发布之后，在 npm 上给这个包打弃用标记。

## What changes

Ruling 7134290286 on the decision card (#36839), R1: the package is retired whole, in one PR, as a patch.

- **Package.** `packages/plugins/knowledge-ragflow/` is deleted (9 files), with its `.changeset/config.json` fixed-group entry and its `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer.
- **Settings page.** `knowledge.manifest.ts` loses the `ragflow` option, the RAGFlow group, its three keys and the `ragflow` branch of "Test connection". Manifest `version` goes 2 → 3 (the spec's "increment when keys are renamed/removed"). The strings go from all eleven locale bundles.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`, `content/docs/ai/index.mdx`, `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`, `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, the `service-knowledge` README and package description, the `embedder-openai` README, `packages/spec/llms.txt` (78 → 77 published packages).
- **Spec.** Comments only, in `knowledge-source.zod.ts`, `contracts/knowledge-adapter.ts` and `contracts/knowledge-service.ts`. No schema, no tombstone, no ADR-0087 conversion: `KnowledgeSource.adapter` stays a free string.
- **Skill.** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` and eval case 3 teach `pgvector` (H3 below).
- **Scripts and ledgers.** Six scripts (comments, one self-test fixture URL, one debt row) and a comment in `.github/workflows/lint.yml`.

### Skill size

| Reading | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` lines | 487 | 487 |
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` tokens (ceiling 6801) | 6798 | 6798 |
| All `SKILL.md` lines | 4961 | 4961 |
| Ratcheted bundle tokens | 199596 | 199596 |

### `git grep -i ragflow` after this PR

`git grep -i ragflow -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!content/docs/releases/v17/**' ':!docs/audits/**'` answers 11 files. Each one:

| File | Hits | Why it stays |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/knowledge.manifest.ts` | 4 | The retired note beside `version: 3` |
| `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/knowledge.manifest.test.ts` | 9 | Absence pins for the option, the group and the three keys; the stored-retired-adapter pin |
| `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx` | 1 | One "retired" row in the adapter table |
| `.changeset/37004-retire-knowledge-ragflow.md` | 13 | This PR's release note |
| `.changeset/33933-knowledge-settings-with-service.md` | 1 | A pending release note of another change, kept as written |
| `.changeset/37292-skill-knowledge-split.md` | 2 | Same |
| `CHANGELOG.md` (root) | 3 | Release history. The acceptance pathspec `**/CHANGELOG.md` does not match the root file |
| `docs/adr/0161-…` | 13 | Deliberate history; `docs/adr/**` stays, apart from one anchor fix (Acceptance notes) |
| `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` | 3 | Lines 311, 329, 446. Release-owned path, not edited in a code PR; the docs-only follow-up is filed as #37481 |
| `scripts/test-shard-timings.json` | 3 | Lines 88, 176, 276. Generated, do-not-hand-edit; the timings refresh workflow drops the rows. The partition self-test passes with them in place |
| `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` | 1 | Line 3456, a frozen fixture of the 2026-11-02 refresh |

### Measurement (a): the settings page for an environment whose stored adapter is `ragflow`

Measured on the settings service with the old manifest registered first (rows written through the door), then this PR's manifest registered over it.

| Door | Answer |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/settings/knowledge` | `200`. Manifest `version` 3, adapter options `memory`, `turso`. `values.adapter` is `{"value":"ragflow","source":"global"}`: served as stored. Value keys served: `adapter`, `turso_url`, `turso_auth_token`, `chunk_target`, `over_fetch`, `enforce_rls`. No `ragflow_*` key is served; the three stored rows are still in the store |
| `POST /api/settings/knowledge/test` (stored values) | `400 SETTINGS_ACTION_FAILED`, "Unknown adapter: ragflow" |
| `PUT` `chunk_target: 900` | `200` |
| `PUT` `adapter: 'ragflow'` | `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION`, "Adapter must be one of: memory, turso. Received 'ragflow'.", field code `invalid_option` |
| `PUT` `ragflow_api_key` | `400 UNKNOWN_KEY` |
| `PUT` `adapter: 'memory'` | `200`; the next read serves `memory` |

In the Console (the real `SettingsField` rendered in jsdom, not a browser): the Adapter select shows **nothing** for the stored `ragflow`, neither a label nor the "Select…" placeholder. `turso` shows its label; an unset value shows the placeholder. The page saves dirty keys only, so editing another field saves; picking an adapter and saving replaces the stored value.

Left behind: the encrypted `ragflow_api_key` row and its `sys_secret` row. No settings door clears them once the key is undeclared. The changeset says how to delete them by hand.

### Measurement (b): a knowledge source declaring an unregistered adapter

`KnowledgeServicePlugin` booted on a kernel with one object source declaring `adapter: 'ragflow'` and no adapter plugin.

| Moment | Answer |
|---|---|
| Boot | Completes. One `info` line: `[knowledge] source registered: kb (adapter=ragflow, kind=object)`. No warning, no error |
| `search` | `[]`, with `warn: [knowledge] source 'kb' references unknown adapter 'ragflow'; skipping.` |
| `searchWithRefusals` | `{"hits":[],"refused":[]}`, same warning. The source is not reported as refused |
| `indexDocument`, `reindexSource` | Throw a bare `Error` (no code, no status): `[knowledge] unknown adapter 'ragflow'. Registered: []` |
| Record upsert / delete events | Resolve; `warn: [knowledge] event-sync failed for source 'kb': …` / `delete failed …` |

**(b) is silent** at boot and on search. It is not changed here; the enforcement card is filed as #37479.

## Tests

- `knowledge.manifest.test.ts`: `version` 3 with absence pins for the three keys and the group (non-vacuity: `turso_url` is there); adapter options are exactly `memory`, `turso`; one new pin, "answers a stored retired adapter (ragflow) as a failure, complete old keys or not", with a passing `turso` call beside it.
- `settings-visibility-declaration.pin.test.ts`: the predicate count goes 87 → 83 (the four `visible` predicates of the RAGFlow group and its keys).
- `knowledge-settings-default-absent.pin.test.ts` and `service-knowledge`'s `knowledge-settings-contribution.test.ts`: the fixture adapter is `turso`.
- The package's own test file (`ragflow-adapter.test.ts`) goes with the package.

Run under the verify lock on `d3692d0c` (after the merge of `main` at `a46efa8c`):

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test` | Test Files 77 passed (77), Tests 1521 passed (1521) |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge test` | Test Files 13 passed (13), Tests 416 passed (416) |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/embedder-openai test` | Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 33 passed (33) |
| `typecheck` of `service-settings` and `service-knowledge` | exit 0 |

After the second merge of `main` (`cc38a91a`), on `cb640fb2`: `service-knowledge` Test Files 14 passed (14), Tests 448 passed (448); `service-settings` 77 files, 1521 tests, unchanged; `service-knowledge` typecheck exit 0.

No ablation run: the change deletes code and edits prose. The one behaviour that moves, a stored `ragflow` reaching "Test connection", has its pin above.

## Acceptance notes

- **H1 (hit count).** The tree was taken as the truth: 50 paths changed, 9 of them the package and 41 outside it. All 8 scripts were looked at: 6 edited, the timings JSON and the frozen fixture line left (see the table).
- **H2 (`lint.yml` premise).** `DEBT` and `TEST_DEBT` in `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` are both `{}` on `main`, so the ledgered closure the step's comment describes was already empty before this card. The comment now says so. The step's `run:` line is unchanged; whether the step still earns its place is a workflow question outside this card.
- **H3 (skill eval).** Case 3 is rewritten, not dropped: the prompt says the deployment runs PostgreSQL with pgvector and the expected answer writes `adapter: 'pgvector'` with no `split` key. Dropping it would lose the only case covering an object source with `where`, `metadataFields` and `refresh`; the in-memory adapter is already case 9.
- **Size.** 50 files changed, 159 insertions, 7041 deletions against `main`, nearly all of it the deleted package and its lockfile entries. That is over the 3000-line threshold for a human merge, on top of the governed paths (`skills/**`, `.github/workflows/lint.yml`).
- **ADR-0161, anchor fix, not a revision.** One table cell (the `adapterConfig` row) named a symbol anchor in the deleted package's `src/index.ts`, and `check:adr-symbol-anchors` refuses an anchor with no tracked file. The cell now names the function and the retired package in prose. No decision text is touched. Agreed with the zone.
- **Serial.** #37439 (zone ai-37000) landed first and is merged in (`main` at `cc38a91a`, no conflict). Its first-build callout in `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` listed RAGFlow among the persistent adapters; that one word is removed here. #37442 (same zone) is still open: `overlap-check` against its head and `main` answers clean at `cb640fb2`. Whichever lands first, the other merges `main` once. #37310 (same zone) rewrites cases 3 and 9 of `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`, the file whose case 3 this PR rewrites; it is coordinated with this card and comes after it.
- **Not edited, deliberately.** `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` (release-owned) and `scripts/test-shard-timings.json` (generated). Both agreed with the zone.
- **Beyond the single hit.** `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`: the Plugins row swaps `knowledge-ragflow` for `knowledge-pgvector` and `knowledge-turso`, which it did not list, so its count goes 17 → 18. `embedder-openai` README: its "no knowledge adapter consumes an `IEmbedder`" paragraph was already untrue (pgvector and turso take one) and is rewritten. `packages/spec/llms.txt`: 78 → 77 published packages (`check:llms-txt` counts the workspace).
- **An earlier pending note is now partly untrue.** `.changeset/33933-…` says clearing the key from Setup removes the stored RAGFlow API key. With the key undeclared that door is gone; this PR's changeset says so and gives the manual deletion. The earlier note is not edited.
- **Pre-existing, not touched.** The docs describe `file` and `http` source kinds; no adapter in this repository ingests them.
- **Seen, not changed here**, and where each went:
  - (1) Measurement (b), the silent unregistered adapter: filed #37479.
  - (2) The Console's blank select for a stored value the manifest no longer offers, and (3) no door clearing a stored secret whose key was removed from a manifest: filed #37480, one card for both.
  - (4) The docs-only releases follow-up: filed #37481.
  - (5) The `lint.yml` step with an empty premise: filed #37482.
  - (6) The three stale rows in the timings JSON: no card; the refresh workflow regenerates the file.
  - (7) ADR-0161 keeps `adapterConfig` in v1 "only while an adapter reads it", and after this PR no adapter in the tree does: no card; #37304 already carries that removal.
  - (8) The earlier pending note about clearing the key from Setup: no card; this PR's changeset corrects it.

## Verification

1. `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/knowledge.manifest.ts`: the removed handler branch. A stored `ragflow` now falls through to the last line, `Unknown adapter`.
